name: H3 second-pass staggered schedule
plain: Builds a second-pass H3 schedule in two separate moves. The starting sigma is copied from a known scheduler, step count and denoise recipe, then a shorter front-loaded curve runs from there to near zero, so the first step does most of the work of removing the upscale grid. This avoids swapping the scheduler name in a trim, which its docstring says reaches a very different start sigma.
math:
total = int(reference_steps/denoise) if denoise<1 else reference_steps.
σ_start = calculate_sigmas(base_scheduler, total)[−(reference_steps+1)].
σ_min = min(max(sampling.sigma_min, 1e-3), σ_start/2).
σ = karras | exponential | polyexponential(steps, σ_min, σ_start, ρ); higher ρ front-loads more.

props.shape: karras, exponential or polyexponential from an anchored start
